tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Read a letter you created (needs its editKey): its content, links, images, and the guests' RSVP answers (yes / maybe / no, plus who hasn't answered).

tools.name: update_letter
tools.description: Change a letter. Only the fields you send change (lang, style… are kept). Links keep working. `guests` replaces the list but keeps each existing guest's id and link (matched by id, then by name); `addGuests` appends without touching anyone else.

tools.name: delete_letter
tools.description: Delete a letter for good (needs its editKey): its links stop working, and guest names, RSVP answers and images are erased.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_letter, update_letter · Private data: create_letter · Public sink: create_letter, update_letter, rate_app · Destructive: create_letter, delete_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_letter, update_letter · Private data: create_letter · Public sink: create_letter, update_letter, rate_app · Destructive: create_letter, delete_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Styles, occasion presets, block types (with examples), envelope slots, stamps and seal options. Call this first to compose a letter." → after: "Styles, occasion presets, block types (with examples), envelope slots, stamps and seal options. Call this first. Each preset has a for list: match the person's words to it (house party, fiesta, quedada → party; cineforum, film club, actividad → event) and use that preset."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
